purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules on gameplay/recovery-v1 differ from what production main deploys. The main gate must see exactly these changes and nothing else. Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

candidate.base: main d1888c33 (r79, runtime 1.9.3-r79; Rules as main 9b8190f0). Candidate adds the r80 END SHOWDOWN ended-early mark (R80-END): the abandon write in cmsPersistentPairAbandonValid may also carry data.endedEarly = {seasonsPlayed: int 0..10 or null}, proven by tests/firebase/ended-early-emulator.cjs; and the r80 Europa League (R80-EL): the Season Results and Season Commit result shapes accept the sparse europaLeague key only as true with championsLeague false for that manager, and ssjrTerminalScore adds EL +3, proven by tests/firebase/europa-league-rules-emulator.cjs. Regenerated with --print-main-delta origin/main.

added: // r80 Europa League: 'europaLeague' is present only when that manager won the EL, and then it is exactly true
// (false is refused, so there is one encoding per fact and old 7-key results are unchanged). One manager's season
// never has CL and EL both true. Nothing compares the two managers' results: both may win the same trophy.
hunks.why: r80 Europa League (plan section 0/1): comment on the Season Results private result shape; no logic.
r80 Europa League: the Season Results private result may also carry the sparse key 'europaLeague'. hasOnly (not hasAll), so the old 7-key result still passes unchanged.

r80 Europa League: the key, when present, must be exactly true and that manager's championsLeague must be false (one manager plays the CL or the EL in a season, never both). Nothing compares the two managers' results.

hunks.why: r80 Europa League: comment on the Season Commit result shape; no logic.
r80 Europa League: the Season Commit result may carry the same sparse key; root.results.playerX == pX.result still binds the commit to the exact private result, key included.
r80 Europa League: the same CL-or-EL rule on the commit, so a private result forged outside the Rules still cannot be committed.

hunks.why: r80 Europa League: comment on ssjrTerminalScore; no logic.
